삼.forms: Sino-Korean · dates, money, minutes, phone numbers, floors (삼 층, 삼월)

재미없다.x: That movie was kind of boring.

똑똑하다.x: My nephew is young but very smart.
똑똑하다.e: Homonym hook: 똑똑 is also the knock-knock sound on a door.

늦잠.x: I overslept yesterday, so I was late for class.
늦잠.t: Always pair it with 자다: 늦잠을 자다, never 늦잠을 하다.

마침내.x: After preparing for three years, I finally passed the exam.
마침내.e: Related to 마치다 'to finish': the point where something is finished.
마침내.t: Like 드디어, it marks a long-awaited result; 결국 can also mean an unwanted outcome.

바뀌다.m: to change, to be changed; to be switched
바뀌다.x: My life changed a lot after I moved.
바뀌다.e: Passive of 바꾸다 'to change, to exchange'.
바뀌다.t: You'll hear 바꼈어요 in speech, but the standard spelling is 바뀌었어요.

등장.x: Life changed a lot with the arrival of smartphones.

고유어.x: Words like 'haneul' (sky) and 'bada' (sea) are native Korean words.

공공요금.ex: 내년부터 전기와 가스 같은 공공요금이 오를 예정입니다.
공공요금.x: Utility rates such as electricity and gas are expected to go up starting next year.
공공요금.t: Covers electricity, gas, water and public transit fares — set or regulated by the government.

외래어.t: 외래어 are borrowed words used in Korean; 외국어 means a foreign language itself.

보건소.ex: 보건소에서 무료로 독감 주사를 맞을 수 있어요.
보건소.x: You can get a free flu shot at the public health center.

씩씩하다.ex: 우리 아이는 병원에서도 울지 않고 씩씩했어요.
씩씩하다.x: My child didn't even cry at the hospital and was really brave.
씩씩하다.t: Adults often praise kids with 씩씩하게 잘했어! 'You did great, so brave!'

붕어빵.ex: 겨울이 되면 동네에 붕어빵 가게가 생겨요.
붕어빵.x: When winter comes, bungeoppang stands pop up in the neighborhood.
붕어빵.e: 붕어 'crucian carp' + 빵 'bread' — named for its shape; there's no fish inside.
붕어빵.t: Usually filled with sweet red bean (팥) or custard (슈크림). People jokingly debate whether to eat the head or tail first.

아이템.m: item (in a game); must-have product; business idea
아이템.ex: 이 아이템을 쓰면 캐릭터가 더 강해져요.
아이템.x: If you use this item, your character gets stronger.
아이템.t: Beyond games, 필수 아이템 means a 'must-have' and 창업 아이템 a business idea.

국적.ex: 그 사람은 한국에서 태어났지만 국적은 미국이에요.
국적.x: He was born in Korea, but his nationality is American.
국적.t: Pronounced [국쩍]; a polite question is 국적이 어떻게 되세요?

중독.x: Smartphone addiction is a big problem these days.
중독.e: Literally 'hit by poison'; 중 here means 'to strike', as in hitting a target.
중독.t: X 중독 = X addiction (게임 중독, 알코올 중독); 식중독 = food poisoning.

목격하다.m: to witness, to see with one's own eyes
목격하다.x: I witnessed a car accident on the street yesterday.
목격하다.t: Used mostly for accidents, crimes or striking events; for ordinary seeing, just use 보다.

소외감.m: sense of alienation, feeling left out
소외감.ex: 새 학교에서 친구가 없어서 소외감을 느꼈어요.
소외감.x: I had no friends at my new school, so I felt left out.
소외감.e: Literally 'the feeling of being kept distant and outside'.

속이 상하다.forms: 속이 상해요 · 속이 상했어요 · 속상해요 (common one-word form)
속이 상하다.m: to be upset, to feel hurt, to be distressed
속이 상하다.ex: 열심히 준비했는데 시험에 떨어져서 속이 상해요.
속이 상하다.x: I prepared so hard but failed the exam, so I'm really upset.
속이 상하다.e: 속 = one's insides; literally 'one's insides get hurt.'
속이 상하다.t: In speech it's usually one word, 속상하다: 정말 속상해 죽겠어요.

바가지.x: I got ripped off on the taxi fare at a tourist spot.
바가지.e: Originally a gourd bowl; why 'wearing the bowl' means getting ripped off is uncertain.
바가지.t: The victim 쓰다 'wears' the 바가지; the seller 씌우다 'puts it on' them.

디플레이션.ex: 디플레이션이 오면 소비가 더 줄어들 수 있어요.
디플레이션.x: If deflation comes, consumer spending could shrink even more.

기본권.x: Freedom of expression is a fundamental right guaranteed by the constitution.
기본권.e: Literally 'basic rights'; -권 = a right: 인권, 투표권.
기본권.t: Pronounced [기본꿘] — the ㄱ in 권 becomes tense.

청탁.ex: 공무원에게 부정한 청탁을 하면 처벌을 받습니다.
청탁.x: You will be punished if you make an improper request to a public official.
청탁.t: In news, 청탁 usually implies an improper favor; for an ordinary favor, use 부탁.

고의로.ex: 그 선수는 고의로 반칙을 해서 경고를 받았어요.
고의로.x: That player got a warning for committing a foul on purpose.
고의로.t: Formal or legal in tone; in daily conversation, 일부러 is more common.

광업.ex: 예전에는 이 도시에서 광업이 중요한 산업이었어요.
광업.x: Mining used to be an important industry in this city.

정형외과.ex: 발목을 다쳐서 정형외과에 가서 엑스레이를 찍었어요.
정형외과.x: I hurt my ankle, so I went to an orthopedic clinic and got an X-ray.
정형외과.e: Literally 'surgical department that restores shape' to bones and joints.
정형외과.t: Don't confuse 정형외과 (orthopedics) with 성형외과 (plastic surgery).

경기 부양.ex: 정부는 경기 부양을 위해 세금을 낮추기로 했습니다.
경기 부양.x: The government decided to cut taxes to stimulate the economy.
경기 부양.e: 경기 = business conditions; 부양 = 'float and lift': lifting the economy up.
경기 부양.t: Don't confuse it with 경기 meaning a game or match; here 경기 means economic conditions.

압수 수색.t: Can take 하다 directly: 압수 수색하다; it requires a 영장 (warrant).

떼.ex: 아이가 장난감을 사 달라고 떼를 썼어요.
떼.x: The child threw a tantrum demanding a toy.
떼.e: Homonym warning: another 떼 means 'crowd, flock', as in 사람들이 떼로 몰려오다.
떼.t: Almost always used as 떼를 쓰다 or 떼쓰다, especially about children.

벼르다.forms: 별러요 · 별렀어요 · 벼를 거예요 · 벼르세요 (르 irregular)
벼르다.m: to be eager for a chance, to bide one's time (to do something); to plan to get back at
벼르다.ex: 그는 지난번 패배를 갚으려고 오랫동안 벼르고 있었어요.
벼르다.x: He had been waiting a long time for a chance to avenge his last defeat.
벼르다.e: Native Korean; suggests nursing a plan and waiting for the right moment, often for revenge.
벼르다.t: Often in the progressive -고 있다 or as 벼르고 벼르던 (long-awaited).
rel: to aim at, to watch for

영공.x: An unidentified aircraft violated our airspace.

생체인식.ex: 요즘 스마트폰은 생체인식으로 잠금을 풀 수 있어요.
생체인식.x: These days smartphones can be unlocked with biometrics.

문인화.ex: 조선의 선비들은 대나무나 매화를 그린 문인화를 즐겼어요.
문인화.x: Joseon scholars enjoyed literati paintings of bamboo and plum blossoms.
문인화.e: Literally 'scholar's painting' — done by educated amateurs, not professional painters.

소리꾼.ex: 소리꾼은 혼자서 여러 인물을 연기하며 노래해요.
소리꾼.x: The pansori singer sings while playing many characters alone.
소리꾼.e: 소리 'sound, song' + -꾼 'person who does it', as in 사냥꾼, 나무꾼.

용납하다.m: to tolerate, to allow, to accept
용납하다.ex: 이런 부정행위는 절대 용납할 수 없습니다.
용납하다.x: This kind of cheating can never be tolerated.
용납하다.t: Mostly negative: 용납할 수 없다 or 용납되지 않는다.

박식하다.ex: 그 교수님은 역사에 대해 정말 박식하세요.
박식하다.x: That professor is truly knowledgeable about history.

스모그.ex: 도시 전체가 짙은 스모그에 덮여 있어요.
스모그.x: The whole city is covered in thick smog.
스모그.e: From English 'smog' (smoke + fog); the extra vowels make it three syllables.
